population: RKSI METAR observations at or before 11:00 Asia/Seoul

weatherCodePolicy.sentinelCondition: IEM returned an explicit blank wxcodes field and the returned RKSI raw METAR has a valid timestamp with no present-weather token
weatherCodePolicy.unavailableCondition: missing wxcodes field, missing or unparsable raw METAR, or a raw METAR present-weather token that conflicts with blank wxcodes
weatherCodePolicy.measurementRule: weather-code normalization never supplies precipitation or any other measurement

historyReadiness.rollingCalendarMonthCoverage: every requested contract date must have one RKSI row; each calendar month is independently ready
